name: As Mart
description: AsMart is an online marketplace based in Bangladesh, specializing in the buying and selling of second-hand products. The platform offers a diverse range of items, including books, electronics, clothing, and accessories, catering to budget-conscious consumers seeking quality pre-owned goods.

name: Portfolio Website
description: Craft Haven is a dynamic marketplace for handcrafted goods. Users can register as buyers or sellers to explore or offer unique, creative items. The platform includes role-based dashboards: sellers can list and manage crafts, buyers can view and purchase products, and admins can manage users and reported listings. It uses Firebase for authentication, Firestore for data storage, and features protected routes, category filtering, and responsive design.

name: Volunteer Vista
description: VolunteerVista is a web application designed to connect volunteers with organizations in need of assistance. The platform facilitates the discovery and participation in various volunteering opportunities, aiming to foster community engagement and support.
